name: True Shuffle
author: moshi
description: Choose equal-chance, no-repeat and discovery modes directly from the shuffle button. Supports the current queue, open playlist or whole library; changes playback only when you choose a mode or apply it.

settings.label: Shuffle shortcut
settings.description: Follow Noctis opens these modes with its Shuffle key (Ctrl+S by default), including keys changed in Settings. Enter another modified key, or off for native keyboard shuffle. No music or queue changes until you choose a mode.

settings.label: Open shuffle controls
settings.description: Flip this switch to open the shuffle window. You can also right-click any song → True Shuffle…. Opening the window does not change playback.

settings.label: For you: new songs
settings.description: How many songs you have not heard yet For you mixes in: about one in ten, one in five, or one in three.

settings.label: Exclude disliked songs by default
settings.description: Off: disliked songs have the same chance as other eligible songs. On: exclude them from all modes.
